name: Rowanvale 1.0 — A softer place to play, grow and unwind
releaseNotes: Rowanvale 1.0 ships the Lamplight design layer, self-hosted typography, a public deployment and a full feature sweep across every view.
changes: Search opens the correct saved media title; reviewed CSV/JSON imports preserve editions and paused statuses
Journals and activity history no longer silently discard older records
Recoverable structured workouts with sets, units, routines and optional rest timer
Search, edit, export and undo private wellbeing history; recover Quiet Room sessions
Dated media diaries, season and episode logs, book editions, copies and rereads
Guest access and setup checks make suggested group lineups more useful
